newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov refinery operating rate at 82.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov refinery operating rate at 82.2 pct.

text.p: The utilisation rate of Japanese oil refineries was at 82.2 percent in November, up from 80.7 percent in the same month last year and up from 70.5 percent in October, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Wednesday.
Crude throughput amounted to 20.7 million kilolitres in November, up 1.7 percent from a year earlier and up 12.8 percent from October, MITI said.
Japan's oil companies currently have a combined refining capacity of 5.3 million barrels-per-stream-day.
